page: Vultr vcg-l40s-64c-750g-192vram is a dedicated GPU-accelerated server belonging to the Cloud GPU family. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by Intel processors with 64 dedicated vCPUs. The system is equipped with 750.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 11.72 GB of RAM per core.

The primary accelerator hardware consists of four NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. For local storage, the instance includes a 2600 GB NVMe SSD. It also comes provisioned with one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given the high density of both system memory and specialized GPU resources, this configuration represents a significant hardware allocation suited for resource-intensive workloads. The combination of 192 GB of total VRAM and 750.0 GB of system RAM makes this server appropriate for large-scale machine learning model training, high-throughput LLM inference, complex 3D rendering, and data science pipelines requiring parallel GPU acceleration.
